chunks: Throw dust into the faces of those who praise excessively.

key_terms.التُّرَابَ: dust; a figurative expression of stern rejection
key_terms.الْمَدَّاحِينَ: those who praise excessively or engage in flattery
key_terms.وُجُوهِ: faces; the object of the emphatic rebuke in the statement

ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم teach about excessive flattery?
ai.summary: This hadith condemns excessive praise and flattery. It teaches believers to reject exaggerated commendation because it can corrupt sincerity, foster arrogance, and damage proper moral conduct.
